Welcome to The White Room

A calming space.
A warm welcome.

Life asks a lot of you. Here, you can take a breath.

The White Room is a quiet, single-client beauty and relaxation salon in Dungannon. With Glenda, every visit is centred around you, with personal attention and treatments tailored to what you need.

From reflexology and soothing massage to a facial or freshly polished nails, make room for the things that help you feel good.

Before your visit

A few helpful things.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the request form to prepare your details and send them to Glenda by text, or call 07707 762663. Your appointment is confirmed only when Glenda replies to agree the treatment and time.

Can I choose a tailored treatment or package?

Yes. Tailored treatments and packages are available on request. Contact Glenda to discuss what you would like and confirm a price before booking.

What if I need to change my appointment?

Call or text Glenda as soon as possible. Ask about the current cancellation policy when arranging your visit.

Is reflexology right for me?

Glenda can discuss your preferences and treatment suitability with you. If you have a medical condition or are pregnant, speak with her before booking; medical advice may be needed. Reflexology is a complementary wellbeing treatment and does not replace medical care.

Where can I find seasonal offers?

See The White Room on Facebook or Instagram for seasonal offers and updates.

Your privacy matters.

The White Room uses the contact and appointment details you choose to share to discuss and arrange your visit. Please do not include health information in this form or a booking text.

In the default request-by-text mode, this page does not send the form to a server or save it in browser storage. Preparing a message does not send it: you review and send it in your messaging app. Your mobile provider’s charges and privacy terms apply.

If an online booking endpoint is configured, submitting the form sends the entered information to The White Room’s appointed booking service. Contact Glenda on 07707 762663 for information about that service, retention of appointment details, or to request access, correction or deletion.
